subject: qplot in loop retaining axis labels

messages.author: 05f098102a2ea7f2
messages.subject: qplot in loop retaining axis labels
parts:
Hi everyone, below is a function I wrote:

plot_hist <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE, ...) {
  for (i in x) {
print(qplot(i,data = x)) }
}

plot_hist(df) 

This gives me a histogram for the values in each column of the dataframe. The axis label for each plot is "i" instead of the usual column name. I've tried a couple variations of using colname() or names() for the df but I can't figure out how to preserve the column names.

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: qplot in loop retaining axis labels
parts:
library(ggplot2)
DF <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100), y = rnorm(100))
nm <- names(DF)
for(i in seq_along(nm))
print(ggplot(DF, aes_string(x = nm[i])) + geom_histogram())

Dennis

messages.subject: Re: qplot in loop retaining axis labels
parts: Works perfectly, thank you for introducing me to seq_along(). This is what I did:

nm <- names(x)
  for (i in seq_along(nm)) {
print(ggplot(x,aes_string(x = nm[i])) + geom_histogram()) }
}

dfc <- df[names(df[6:9])]  ## subset df to columns containing numeric scores
plot_hist(dfc)
